title: Multiple case branches in one update
prompt: What does this return? Read it — do not run it.

given.script:
%dw 2.0
output application/json
---
{id: 1, status: "active", priority: 1} update {
  case .status -> "inactive"
  case .priority -> 99
}

solution:
%dw 2.0
output application/json
---
{id: 1, status: "active", priority: 1} update {
  case .status -> "inactive"
  case .priority -> 99
}

explanation.approach: You can update multiple fields at once by listing multiple `case` statements. Both `status` and `priority` changed.
